crossFamilyComparisons.finding: Compare actual ToDoo overview against notebook and settings: corresponding slim persistent primary rail, workspace context column, vertical alignment, light rows, blue/tinted selection and small controls. Keep 64/56/208 as style reference with actual user-resizable knowledge tree and compact drawer/identity trigger. Use token CSS for normalized chroma, focus, borders and padding.

S001 visibly has light and dark preference preview blocks, other sampled full hosts primarily light. Exact light/dark ink, paper, accent and focus colors come from apps/web/to-doo-tokens.css. Whole-app dark contrast in Ant, Naive and rendering engines is an implementation/runtime check. Specimen gradients/shading and raster blue variation have no CSS numeric authority.

Login required fields and single submit; OAuth domain form uses allowedPolicy and optional offline_access only, with distinct legacy/non-policy rendering, allow/deny disabled while busy. Read-only guest has article and TOC; valid editable share has its own small toolbar. Blank dirty content may be saved; readonly/403, missing/404, expectedModifiedAt/409 and conditional retry/reload retain the draft as specified. Actual grants and HTTP capability execution remain untested.

Owner blog has its local overview and actions. Journal uses a single text feed, magazine uses broad headline/card grid, profile separates author and editorial modules. Green example accent/serif/spacing belong to blog settings; retain custom accent, type scale, reading width, templates and privacy. Publishing history restores drafts only. Authenticated GET private preview has private banner and standalone SSR canvas, distinct from viewport controls and public home.

Shared private host and mode group surround distinct whiteboard tools, colored mindmap and Mermaid authoring/preview. Stamp UI tokens on common chrome, preserve user/content colors and vendor controls. No phone eyedropper on VR001 v2. Reachable drawing geometry is a target; historical find/library offscreen at 390, CommandPalette unmounted and mobile stats not rendered stay explicit.

Tree placement/empty result remain actual selector. Dense SSH/client/permission forms have dedicated error/disabled examples and bottom actions. Rename and rotation differ from issuance; do not transplant name to expiry-only or restore to nonrestorable mode. Transfer/data jobs preserve state-specific cancellation, resume, download and output reconciliation. Git raw/inline diff, saved revision tabs/source, loaded split/narrow unified table and footer receipt are distinct regions. Standalone print/HTML has independent reading surface.

roleAndStateFindings: Owner navigation keeps notebook tree resize/collapse, owner actions and route-local contextual nav. Login and deployment notice, private OAuth consent, guest shared reading/editing, public blog and print have role-appropriate shells. Browser registration, password-gated shares, added roles and new AI operations are outside the source contract.

Five dormant surfaces and PB060 HTTP-only replies are explicitly tracked. PB016 is source-conditional. Graph clues, deferred restore, retry and unknown results retain their data/guard distinctions. Blog preview and draft-history restore preserve publication boundaries.

Pre-existing draw-only deviations are tied to concrete implementation guidance: preserve the ordinary role=status for clipboard notices, real Ant warning severity, source menus without artificial controls/arrows, and theme/content/user brand configuration.

resolvedDesignFindings.evidence: WS-M020 reviewed separately. A supplies actual collection-update status and refresh action. B supplies the complete invalid-URL field/error and enabled Save; changed/blocked messages use the same span. C supplies conditional parent receipt action, composed with the retained D037 fragment and D039 leave dialog. Existing D007/008 skeletons, D009 retained-list retry, R004 empty/end, D004 actual enabled menu and D041 actual fallback have source-specific visibility/substitution records. WS097 uses compact D074 identity anchor plus D004 contents and source placement. Saved-history M009, graph M012 and search M018 effective rows were checked against their pictures; 81 copied pattern tables are historical and contradictory parent coordinates moved to originalPlanRow.

ST015 resolves both D019 and R010 A/B and retains root/writable+organizable host restrictions. ST043 combines D034 full three-field change-password with R015 geometry and preserves its own actions. PB045 combines D110 project-specific title/url/description textarea with R072 ordered list spacing/actions. WS074 uses R028 diagram chrome plus D054 projection, with only article typography from R050. WS106 uses R034 A/B lists with note-projection data and no inherited knowledge-entity actions. Literal compact modes and geometry-only widths are distinguished.

additionalRegionalReuse: WS072 diagram-source mobile is assembled from diagram mode chrome and its actual markdown/gutter/body; ordinary notebook source supplies only explicitly limited text/caret geometry. WS-M019 shows loaded structured diff wide and narrow; Git and saved toolbar ownership stays distinct.

ST068 rotation and ST069 reissue use their true C-panel mode at 320 and source single-column adaptation for 390. The A/B forms are different modes. Shared components inherit source-specific message/data/guard changes, not unrelated controls.

MCP effective and already granted policy sections use different authorized manager/detail regions. Long import/restore/transfer retain conditional credentials, item status, cancellation/retry and resume-by-source. The outbound HTTP or stored permission effect has separate runtime coverage.
limitations: No product/server or real Git/plugin/backup integration started; no inferred request success, credentials, permission execution, scroll, hit testing, keyboard, focus or device support.

PB060 HTTP-only; PB016 conditional setup notice; no account registration, forgot-password, share password gate, team roles or additional AI features. Exact command-palette and mobile stats absence based on locked package, preserved negative runtime attempts.

Visual cross-review is a representative set of independently SHA-verified current PNGs; remaining assets have their own source-bound per-image reviews. Source-only CSS and component guards supplement visible data.
ST015 uses same DirectoryTreeSelect with independent ST014 writable-organizable restriction; public templates, blogs, print and OAuth do not inherit private navigation.

History diff toolbar placement differs in Git vs saved branch; renderer fallback/raw diff is not loaded parsed grid. Reconciliation and restore guards, CAS, retained guest draft, public capability permissions require separate runtime proof.

Device keyboard/focus trapping & return, full-page dark contrasts, long form inner scrolling, actual responsive hit boxes incl. 390 offscreen vendor sidebar remain open implementation acceptance criteria.
handoff: Design evidence is ready for the root strict gate and subsequent implementation. Runtime acceptance, release verification and deployment are outside this report.
